name: native score points
lua_assertions:
local function weight(hold, score, expected, beginner)
  local dance, grade = _ITG_SCORE_WEIGHT(hold, score, beginner or false)
  assert(dance == expected and grade == expected, score .. ': ' .. dance .. ', ' .. grade)
end
local function possible(before, after, expected)
  local dance, grade = _ITG_SCORE_POSSIBLE(before, after, 2)
  assert(dance == expected and grade == expected, 'possible: ' .. dance .. ', ' .. grade)
end
for _, mode in ipairs({'ITG', 'FA+', 'Casual'}) do
  _ITG_SCORE_CONFIG(mode, true, false)
  local scores = mode == 'ITG' and {5, 4, 2, 0, -6, -12}
    or mode == 'FA+' and {5, 5, 4, 2, 0, -12} or {3, 2, 1, 0, 0, 0}
  for index = 1, 5 do weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_W' .. index, scores[index]) end
  weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_Miss', scores[6])
  weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_None', 0)
  weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_HitMine', mode == 'Casual' and -1 or -6)
  weight(true, 'HoldNoteScore_Held', scores[1])
  weight(true, 'HoldNoteScore_LetGo', 0)
  weight(true, 'HoldNoteScore_MissedHold', 0)
  weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_CheckpointHit', 0)
  local d, g = _ITG_SCORE_WEIGHT(false, 'TapNoteScore_CheckpointMiss', false)
  assert(d == 0 and g == -8)
  possible('1100\n0000\n0000\n0000', nil, scores[1])
end
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', false, false)
weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_W1', 4)
possible('1100\n0000\n0000\n0000', nil, 4)
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', true, true)
weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_Miss', 0, true)
weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_HitMine', 0, true)
weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_Miss', -12, false)
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', true, false)
weight(false, 'TapNoteScore_Miss', -12, true)
possible('1100\n0000\n0000\n0000', '0000\n0000\n0000\n0000', 5)
possible('1000\n0000\n0000\n0000', '1000\n0100\n0000\n0000', 10)
possible('1100\n2100\n3000\n00M0', nil, 15)
possible('4000\n3000\n0000\n0000', nil, 10)
possible('F000\n0000\n0000\n0000', nil, 0)
possible('L000\n0000\n0000\n0000', nil, 5)
assert(not pcall(function() _ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('unknown', true, false) end))
_ITG_SCORE_CONFIG('ITG', true, false)
local p1 = _ITG_STAGE_STATS('PlayerNumber_P1')
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17', p1:GetGrade())
p1:SetDancePointLimits(8, 10)
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Tier17', p1:GetGrade())
p1:FailPlayer()
assert(p1:GetGrade() == 'Grade_Failed', p1:GetGrade())
